LedgerConfig.title: LedgerConfig
LedgerConfig.description: Configuration, opening balances, and member list for a clan emergency fund ledger.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this ledger.

clanName.description: Display name of the clan emergency fund.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the ledger.

cashReserveTarget.description: Recommended liquid cash floor on hand.

priorIncluded.description: Whether the opening balance forward is included in totals.

priorLabel.description: Label for the opening balance forward.

priorDate.description: Reference date for the opening balance forward.

priorAmountOnHand.description: Opening Cash on Hand balance prior to April 27, 2026.

priorBpiMoneyMarket.description: Opening BPI Money Market Fund balance prior to April 27, 2026.

priorBpiShortTerm.description: Opening BPI Short Term Fund balance prior to April 27, 2026.

members.description: Bounded list of clan contributor names (max 30).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the ledger was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the ledger was last updated.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: A single contribution, medical disbursement, transfer, or yield entry in the clan E-Fund ledger.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns the parent ledger.

memberOrBeneficiary.description: Clan member or beneficiary associated with the transaction.

amountOnHand.description: PHP amount added to or deducted from Cash on Hand.

bpiMoneyMarket.description: PHP amount added to or deducted from BPI Money Market Fund.

bpiShortTerm.description: PHP amount added to or deducted from BPI Short Term Fund.

memberLoan.description: PHP amount added to or deducted from Member Loan / Receivable bucket.

highlightAlert.description: Whether this transaction is flagged as an urgent medical disbursement.

notes.description: Optional audit note or receipt reference.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was last updated.

MamasSavingsDoc.title: MamasSavingsDoc
MamasSavingsDoc.description: Private savings ledger and record state strictly restricted to the account manager (jrjacob2000@gmail.com).

loanToMhariz.description: Loan receivable from Mhariz in PHP.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the savings document was last updated.

/ledgers/{ledgerId}.description: Stores the clan emergency fund configuration and opening balances owned by an authenticated user.

/ledgers/{ledgerId}/transactions/{transa.description: Stores individual E-Fund ledger transactions belonging to a specific ledger.

/mamas_savings/{docId}.description: Private personal savings account strictly accessible only by the authorized manager (jrjacob2000@gmail.com).
